overview: Before light, with both locks off, you kept nine shillings out for the journey and counted the rest. The rest was thirty-three pounds, even. You did not add the nine back, and you did not write another total beside it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Kept nine shillings out and did not fold them back into the total.

summary: Counted thirty-three pounds and kept nine shillings out
